keyFindings.description: Deleting CredentialRecordPage leaves MachineLoginPage as the one caller, and its record comes only from POST /v1/machine-logins/lookup, which selects launcher_credential records (handlers_ui_machinelogin.go:27-54) whose ReadRecord leaves Enrollment nil (machine_read.go:785-790) and whose session ids are both null (handlers_ui_records.go:31-33). So the Kind fact's 'Secret request' side (:72), the Enrollment formatting (:76-78), the Worker slot fact (:80), the Session fact with its useAgents call (:64-67, :81-90) and the kind check at :115 can no longer carry anything. Their only tests were the deleted CredentialRecordPage*.test.tsx. The prose this PR rewrote says the machine page renders them: packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md:851 and :863-868, CredentialSessionLines.tsx:37 and :50, session.ts:23. Remove the unreachable parts and make that prose name what a machine login shows.

waitingOn (:1107-1126) now holds two switches that differ only by the ': ' + brokerPage suffix. One switch with that suffix gives all six sentences byte for byte, so the wording lives once and TestAPendingRequestWithoutABrokerPageNamesItsApproverAlone stops guarding a copy.

The test at :1029 is titled 'a credential record path with no approve_url renders an unlinked row' but visits / and reads the Inbox row; the title carries the phrase only so -g 'credential record path' selects it. Title it for what it does and select both rows another way (a test.describe('credential record path', ...) around them keeps the acceptance command unchanged).
Fixed by the reviewer in c305b742: :4731 said relaysDecisions covers 'the ten routes'; routes_table.go has nine such rows at this head (ten at the base).

notAdopted: Rendering InboxPage at /credentials/* rather than a <Navigate> to /, and the routeIsInbox mirror it needs: the plan's departure D1 chose it with evidence and the tester drove /credentials, /credentials/machine, /credentials/machine/extra and a query string against it; react-router 6.30.6 ranks the static machine path above the splat whatever the order. Not a defect.
RequestStatus.RecordID in cmd/agent-secrets/client.go, no longer read: that struct is documented as GET /v1/requests/{id}'s exact response shape, so the field stays with the wire shape.

agent-secrets' no-page sentences say 'on the secrets broker' though a broker with no page has none: the plan's D2 settled that wording, the architect was told, and only a broker rolled back past INFRA-878 reaches it.
brokerPage.ts with one caller and approveURL()'s name: a named helper carrying the URL-safety rule, and a name that predates this change; neither is a defect.
